details.description: Amazon Nova Micro is Amazon's text-only foundation model, launched December 5, 2024 and accessed through Amazon Bedrock. It takes text input and generates text output only, with a 128K-token context window, and does not accept image, video or document inputs. It supports the Converse API, response streaming and client-side tool calling, and Amazon positions it for interactive chat, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic applications where speed and cost matter more than multimodal input. AWS's Bedrock model card lists this v1 snapshot as Active, with no end-of-life date announced as of this research.
advantages: Supports client-side tool calling, response streaming and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails (AWS Bedrock model card).
Supports explicit prompt caching, with a minimum of 1K tokens per cache checkpoint and up to 4 checkpoints per request (AWS Bedrock model card).
Supports fine-tuning and provisioned throughput for dedicated capacity (AWS Bedrock model card).
Optimized for 15 named languages within a training set Amazon says spans up to 200 languages (Amazon Nova user guide).
disadvantages: Text-only: does not accept image, video or document inputs, unlike Nova Lite and Nova Pro (Amazon Nova user guide).
Does not support structured outputs via the bedrock-runtime API (AWS Bedrock model card).
Knowledge cutoff of October 2024 (AWS Bedrock model card).
use_cases: Agentic applications requiring fast, low-latency text responses
